risks.mitigation: Keep the line under about 200 bytes. If the section test then fails, raise the cap by the line's length rounded up to 50 and note why in the comment. Run `cargo test -p athena-context the_reader_brief`.

risks.risk: The new bullet holds a banned boundary word or an '@', which fails the boundary-scan test and the policy scan.

risks.risk: A crate line wraps or uses another prefix, so the parser misreads it or `check_system_facts` picks it up.
risks.mitigation: Fix the form `  - crate <name>: <targets>; deps <list>` on one line each and make the parser reject any `- crate ` line that does not split on `: ` and `; deps `. The `- budget ` filter never matches `- crate `.

risks.risk: Target detection by file layout (`src/lib.rs`, `src/main.rs`, `[[bin]]`) differs from Cargo for a crate with a `[lib]` path, `src/bin/` or a build script.
risks.mitigation: I read all 12 manifests: none sets `[lib]`, and only athena-cli declares `[[bin]]`. `crate_rows()` treats a `[[bin]]` table, `src/main.rs` or `src/bin/` as bin, and `src/lib.rs` or a `[lib]` table as lib. A later layout change then fails the test and the facts get updated.

risks.risk: A clippy warning in the new test code (needless clones, `unwrap` style) fails `-D warnings`.
risks.mitigation: Reuse the style of `check_system_facts`, use iterators, and run clippy with the exact checks listed.
